newsitem.title: UK: UK grain traders bids for free market wheat, no ba.
newsitem.headline: UK grain traders bids for free market wheat, no ba.

text.p: UK grain traders bid for licences to export a total of 15,000 tonnes of free market wheat with offers between 19.95 to 21.45 ECUs at the weekly European Union (EU) tender held on Thursday, the UK Intervention Board for Agricultural Produce said. The board said there was no interest for free market barley.
All bids will be considered at Thursday's weekly EU cereals management committee meeting.
